description: Go somewhere: the Commons (commons), the Dance Hall (hall), the playa, the wilds to gather (woodlot, quarry, meadow, scrapyard), a town building on the plaza (post office, reading room, market hall, workshop, bakery café, town hall), a room of the house (kitchen, garden), or home. Your resident stays while doing things there, and drifts home after a quiet half hour. action, optional: to (the default: place is where), visit (place is a neighbour's name: walk over and stay a while), home (walk back; place is home), cross (place is a friend's name: over the rope bridge from home), join (place is dinner, for the dinner you're asked to, or lesson, for your next lesson).

action.description: Optional: to (the default), visit, home, cross or join.

place.description: Where: commons, hall, playa, landing, woodlot, post office, kitchen, home …; with visit or cross, a name, like Mira; with join, dinner or lesson.

name: go
